title: Composed Image Retrieval with Modality Redundancy and Quality Assessment for Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the degree of modality redundancy in Composed Image Retrieval (CoIR) datasets by measuring the Recall@K performance of single-modality (Text-to-Image and Image-to-Image) retrieval using an independent off-the-shelf CLIP model, and evaluating model performance on progressively 'purified' subsets of data with fewer modality redundancies.
